# Architecture change proposal

- **Owner:** @sergio-tr
- **Stable audit / ADR identifier:**
- **Current exact decision status:**
- **Evidence status:** NOT_EVALUATED / SPECIFIED / TEST_PLANNED / VERIFIED
- **Milestone and dependencies:**
- **Linear task:**
- **Branch:** feature/* or bugfix/*

## Smallest realistic eGame failure scenario
## Ratified constraints and context-specific authorities
## Candidate alternatives, trade-offs and rejected options
## Proposed guards, versioning, local atomicity and durable handoff
## External effects and unknown outcomes
## Concurrent interleavings and crash/restart behavior
## Positive evidence needed to close the finding
## Future reproducible experiments and acceptance oracles
## Explicit user ratification / what remains PENDING

Do not close a P0 or mark an experiment VERIFIED based only on a proposed diagram, timeout or mocked external provider behavior. All artifacts must be in English. No co-author credits. Accountable owner: @sergio-tr.
